text:
Grace (People Ops): Heads-up  new hire Lucia Santos starts Mon but is relocating from out of state and requested a bilingual orientation (English/Spanish). Need I-9 verification options, BG status, laptop imaging, and a short benefits Q&A covering domestic partner coverage. Who's on reception?
Anya (Hiring Manager): I can meet her at reception 09:00 and do a quick team intro. I'll ask if she prefers English or Spanish for benefits.
Sam (Relocation): Lucia arrives at 08:30 shuttle from 3rd Ave. I'll leave a relocation packet at reception with local transit info and neighborhood childcare resources she asked about.
Diego (IT): Imaging slot 09:15-09:35 reserved. MacBook Air 13" labelled "Lucia S". Will include USB-C hub and headphones. If she's remote on day 1, I can do a 16:00 remote MDM helper.
bg-check-bot: Background check link sent to lucia.santos@redwood.ai  status: pending consent. Reminder scheduled in 8 hours.
Grace (People Ops): I-9 options: preferred in-person at kiosk same-day. If originals aren't available, remote verifier allowed within 3 business days (show originals on camera and upload scans). Please note: payroll needs I-9 on file before benefits auto-enroll.
Anya (Hiring Manager): Lucia said she might only have driver's license and a birth certificate this week. Is that an acceptable combo?
Grace (People Ops): DL + Social Security card is standard. Birth certificate alone isn't acceptable for List B. If she lacks SS card, we'll schedule remote verifier and mark HRIS "I-9 pending". We'll still enroll her in benefits on Day 1 but note limited access to certain systems until BG and I-9 are complete.
Diego (IT): Security policy: permanent network credentials issued only after BG green and I-9 verified. We can grant LMS/training access and non-prod tooling for the first week to let her start ramping. Confirm if training access is OK.
Anya (Hiring Manager): Training access is fine. She will need access to onboarding LMS and team docs day 1.
hr-bot: Benefits note: domestic partner coverage requires signed affidavit + proof of shared residence; enrollment window is 30 days from start. I'll attach the domestic partner form to the Day-1 email.
Sam (Relocation): I'll confirm pickup details and leave a welcome card in Spanish/English. Also booking a short bilingual campus tour at 11:00.
Grace (People Ops): Action items: 1) Anya meet reception 09:00 2) Diego imaging 09:15 & leave laptop at reception 3) Sam arrange shuttle pickup + packet 4) People Ops send bilingual Day-1 email with GoodHire, W-4, DD links and domestic partner form 5) Grant LMS access pending BG/I-9 green.
bg-check-bot: Update: consent received  screening in progress.
Diego (IT): I'll pre-create email/github accounts and send temporary reset to her personal address. Will hold off on VPN prod access until security sign-off.
Anya (Hiring Manager): Thanks  I'll greet her in Spanish if she prefers. Lucia, welcome! :tada:
Grace (People Ops): Thank you everyone  I'll post the final checklist to Lucia and cc the team.
